label: Grand Interior
description: Large public interiors — halls, atriums, terminals and stages; any subject.

items.name: museum-atrium
items.text: A skylit museum atrium, white marble floors and a suspended sculpture turning slowly over the void between gallery balconies.

items.name: grand-library
items.text: A grand reading room, green-shaded lamps down long oak tables beneath a coffered barrel vault, book galleries behind brass rails.

items.name: opera-house
items.text: An opera house auditorium, tiers of gilded boxes rising in a horseshoe around red velvet stalls beneath a painted dome and crystal chandelier.

items.name: railway-concourse
items.text: A historic railway concourse beneath a glazed iron train shed, split-flap destination boards and polished stone floors reflecting the ribs above.

items.name: airport-terminal
items.text: A contemporary airport terminal, a wave-form ceiling of white steel ribs over glass walls, empty check-in islands on terrazzo.

items.name: grand-hotel-lobby
items.text: A grand hotel lobby, double-height columns of book-matched marble, a brass elevator bank and a towering floral centerpiece on a round table.

items.name: palace-ballroom
items.text: An empty palace ballroom, parquet de Versailles underfoot, mirrored walls multiplying crystal chandeliers into golden depth.

items.name: arena-stage
items.text: An empty arena stage, rigging trusses and moving-head beams over a glossy black deck, haze hanging in the shafts of light.

items.name: victorian-palm-house
items.text: A Victorian palm house, white iron ribs and thousands of glass panes arching over dense tropical planting and dripping humidity.

items.name: glass-galleria
items.text: A 19th-century shopping galleria, mosaic marble floors beneath a barrel-vaulted glass and iron roof, gilded storefronts rising four storeys to the lunettes.

items.name: underground-cistern
items.text: An underground cistern hall, a forest of salvaged marble columns rising from black water, walkways skimming the surface between uplit capitals.

items.name: victorian-swimming-baths
items.text: A Victorian swimming bath hall, glazed brick in cream and green, cast-iron spectator galleries above still turquoise water and numbered changing stalls along the poolside.
